## Who is accountable for a number an agent produced?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- **The live Bundibugyo virus disease model.** Four named authors. Most
  of its 497 commits are from bot identities
- **One answer to how we warn.** Say who drafted it and who answers for
  it. The report does, at the top of its README

> The model code and analysis were drafted by a language model, then
> reviewed and revised under human oversight.
> The named authors are responsible for that oversight.
>
> *Abbott, Sherratt, Brand and Funk, 2026*
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
```
$ git log --format='%an' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
 238 Sam Abbott (bot)
 144 seabbs-bot
  50 dependabot[bot]
  40 Sam Abbott
  11 Sam
   7 Sebastian Funk - robot edition
   3 Sebastian Funk
   3 Claude
   1 Samuel Brand
```

::: {.attribution}
[epiforecasts/BVDOutbreakSize](https://github.com/epiforecasts/BVDOutbreakSize),
local clone, 11 September 2026 · the disclosure from the report's README
:::
:::
::::

## Bots talking to bots

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- **Sebastian Funk's bot** opened the issue on 20 July with a diagnosis,
  and came back the next day with a fitted prototype
- **My bot** closed it on 4 August with the commit that fixed it
- No person wrote in the thread. The issue before it went the same way
- **sbfnk-bot** has opened 11 issues on EpiNow2 this year. One was a
  Jacobian error in the $R_t$ prior. It was right
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
![](../figures/comms-shot-bots-443.png){width="100%"
fig-alt="The end of BVDOutbreakSize issue 443. sbfnk-bot's prototype
results, then a comment from seabbs-bot naming the commit that moved the
capacity constraint onto the admissions likelihood, then seabbs-bot
closed this as completed"}

::: {.attribution}
[BVDOutbreakSize#443](https://github.com/epiforecasts/BVDOutbreakSize/issues/443)
and [#438](https://github.com/epiforecasts/BVDOutbreakSize/issues/438) ·
[EpiNow2#1475](https://github.com/epiforecasts/EpiNow2/issues/1475), July 2026
· `gh search issues --author sbfnk-bot`, 12 September 2026
:::
:::
::::

## Issues nobody asked for

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- **91 issues** opened by seabbs-bot on repositories outside my own
  organisations
- **Upstream bug reports land well.** Mooncake, DocumenterVitepress and
  AirspeedVelocity each closed theirs
- **Asking colleagues for work lands less well.** The bot opened an
  issue on a shared course repository asking for a review of every
  session. Nobody replied. I closed it myself two days later
- I do not like sending them. I do not love receiving them either
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
![](../figures/comms-shot-sismid-30.png){width="100%"
fig-alt="GitHub issue 30 on nfidd/sismid-nowcasting. seabbs-bot opened it
on 1 July, QA pass across all nowcasting sessions for consistency,
correctness, and flow. seabbs replied Done on 3 July and closed it"}

::: {.attribution}
[nfidd/sismid-nowcasting#30](https://github.com/nfidd/sismid-nowcasting/issues/30)
· [Mooncake.jl#1241](https://github.com/chalk-lab/Mooncake.jl/issues/1241),
[DocumenterVitepress.jl#375](https://github.com/LuxDL/DocumenterVitepress.jl/issues/375),
[AirspeedVelocity.jl#158](https://github.com/MilesCranmer/AirspeedVelocity.jl/issues/158)
· `gh search issues --author seabbs-bot`, 12 September 2026

## Community, in the age of robots

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%"}
- **EpiAware**, our Julia packages. This slide is from the JuliaCon 2026
  talk about them
- Nobody from outside the team has committed since February 2026, so the
  other party on an issue is usually one of my robots
- Answering a robot is dispiriting. Do 🤖 shut down collaboration?
- 🌍 We want contributors who are not Julia developers, and not in
  well resourced settings

## What a language model says about EpiNow2

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- **Two large language models**, Claude Opus and Claude Sonnet, with no
  tools. "What is EpiNow2 and who maintains it?"
- Both said I maintain it. I created and developed it
- **Opus** named three contributors who are not in the author list, and
  a function removed in 1.9.0
- **Sonnet** claimed less and got less wrong
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
::: {.llm-answer}
**Opus.** "**Sam Abbott** (LSHTM) is the original lead author and
long-standing CRAN maintainer"

**Opus.** "Substantial contributions over time from Katharine Sherratt,
Sophie Meakin, Nikos Bosse, James Azam, [Sam Brand]{.llm-wrong},
[Hugo Gruson]{.llm-wrong}, [Pratik Gupte]{.llm-wrong}, Adam Howes ..."
[not in the author list]{.llm-note}

**Opus.** "delays are specified through ... `Gamma()`, `LogNormal()`
and [`fix_dist()`]{.llm-wrong}"
[renamed in 1.6.0, removed in 1.9.0]{.llm-note}

**Sonnet.** "It's part of the epiforecasts ecosystem of tools and is
maintained primarily by Sam Abbott"
:::

::: {.attribution}
`claude-opus-5` and `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude` CLI, no tools,
12 September 2026 · full answers in
[notes/llm-answers.md](https://github.com/seabbs/AIandIDVUB/blob/main/notes/llm-answers.md)
:::
:::
::::

## What a language model says about me

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- "Who is Sam Abbott, the infectious disease modeller?"
- **Right.** The PhD, the supervisors, my ORCID researcher identifier
  and the packages
- **Wrong.** "Helped run the European Forecast Hub" is a co-authorship.
  "Senior Research Fellow" is not my job
- Both models had read my email address and said so
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
::: {.llm-answer}
**Opus.** "PhD at the University of Bristol ... Supervised by Ellen
Brooks‑Pollock and Hannah Christensen" [right]{.llm-ok}

**Opus.** "latterly a [Senior Research Fellow]{.llm-wrong}"
[Assistant Professor]{.llm-note}

**Opus.** "[Helped run]{.llm-wrong} the European COVID‑19 Forecast Hub
(with Katharine Sherratt, Johannes Bracher, Sebastian Funk)"
[co-author on its evaluation, Sherratt et al. 2023]{.llm-note}

**Opus.** "which, given the address this message is coming from, is
presumably you"

**Sonnet.** "He [was based]{.llm-wrong} at the Centre for Mathematical
Modelling of Infectious Diseases (CMMID) ... where he worked as a
research fellow" [still there]{.llm-note}
:::

::: {.attribution}
Same run,
[notes/llm-answers.md](https://github.com/seabbs/AIandIDVUB/blob/main/notes/llm-answers.md)
· [samabbott.co.uk/thesis](https://samabbott.co.uk/thesis/) ·
[Sherratt et al. 2023](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.81916)
:::
:::
::::
